import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Read the provided CSV
df = pd.read_csv('/mnt/uploads/sales.csv')

# Aggregate revenue by month and region, then index each region to January = 100
monthly = df.groupby(['month', 'region'], as_index=False)['revenue'].sum()
pivot = monthly.pivot(index='month', columns='region', values='revenue').sort_index()
indexed = pivot.div(pivot.loc['2026-01']).mul(100)

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 5))
for region in indexed.columns:
    ax.plot(indexed.index, indexed[region], marker='o', label=region)
ax.set_title('Revenue by Region (January = 100)')
ax.set_xlabel('Month')
ax.set_ylabel('Revenue index (January = 100)')
ax.set_ylim(0, indexed.max().max() * 1.1)
ax.legend(title='Region')
ax.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
fig.tight_layout()
plt.show()
